description:
Murder, escape, theft, stalking! 
Jaeho misunderstands Taein as a criminal, but due to a film project assignment, they become a team, and in the process of getting to know him, Jaeho is swept up by Taein, who is direct and forward with his feelings.
These two, with the contrasting titles of "Endless NG" (No Good/mistake) and "Retake Master," will they really be able to finish shooting the movie successfully?

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/shout_it), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/shout_it), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000076568), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13799334), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260125), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68807039)
